name: Dime Loans API
description:
The Dime Loans API provides endpoints for loan management across three authentication layers:

- **`/api/auth/`** — Customer PIN-based authentication for individual borrowers
- **`/api/partner/`** — Partner API key-based authentication for company/employer apps
- **`/api/main/`** — General loan operations supporting both customer and partner tokens
- **`/api/customer/`** — Customer-facing data endpoints
- **`/api/transact/`** — Payment processing endpoints

### Phone Number Format
All phone numbers must be in E.164 format: `254XXXXXXXXX`

### Amount Format
All monetary amounts must be sent as **strings**, not numbers.
